no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: CareDx is a transplant diagnostics, digital health, and patient-services company. It develops molecular diagnostics (cell-free DNA, NGS HLA typing, gene expression) and software for organ and stem-cell transplant patients. It has no proprietary drug or therapeutic pipeline and no Phase 1/2/3 clinical drug studies. All sponsored ctgov studies are observational registries / clinical-utility studies for its diagnostic assays.
